parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Emily: Hello Elite Travel. This is Emily speaking. How may I assist you today?

Customer: Hi, I have a group visit to plan and I wonder whether you could help me decide on which hotel to book. I've narrowed it down to either the Winchester, the Royal Hotel or the Star Hotel. I'm wondering if you have a recommendation.

Emily: I would be happy to help. Those three are excellent choices. If everyone is booking rooms independently, an easy way to do it is online booking. The Star Hotel offers online bookings at no additional charge.

Customer: It sounds fine.

Emily: Yeah, and you can even book the gorgeous sea view rooms if you act quickly.

Customer: Hmm, I'll consider that. It would be great since we are mostly first time visitors to the area to get a nice view of the water. Now, are there handicapped accessible rooms?

Emily: Yes, all three options have access for the physically disabled.

Customer: Great. I should also mention that we'll be on a tight schedule, so we won't have much time to go out for meals. Which of these hotels serve food?

Emily: There is a limited continental breakfast menu at the Star and at the Winchester. For a full restaurant and room service, the Royal Hotel is your best bet.

Customer: Oh, wonderful. Could you tell me more about the restaurant?

Emily: Absolutely. In the morning, there is a gourmet buffet or a la carte items, and after 11 a.m. lunch is served in the dining room. Dinners are in a nice low-key but high-quality setting in the hotel's private dining room, and Fridays feature the house jazz band.

Customer: How lovely. Is there a group discount?

Emily: No, sorry, not at the Royal Hotel. Let me check on the others, though. Could I place you on hold for just a second?

Customer: Sure, thanks.

Emily: It looks like there is one at the Winchester, 15% off when you book eight or more rooms.

Customer: Really? Sold! We'll book at the Winchester. Wait, is it suitable for children, though? We'll have a few little ones in our group and it would be great to have a way to keep them occupied.

Emily: Yes, in fact, it has a play place that kids just love, with slides and swings and everything. Definitely a good hotel to bring the kids.

Customer: Okay, great. So now I know where we'll be staying. What next? Should I go ahead and book transportation and assign rooms and everything?

Emily: Well, for now there are only a few things for you to take care of. I'll hold the block of rooms for you as soon as you send a deposit. I recommend booking as soon as possible, so you probably want to send the invitations as soon as you know how many rooms to hold.

Customer: All right, okay. I'll send the invitations and put down the deposit. Is there anything else I should take care of?

Emily: Great, and don't worry about this now, but sometime before you arrive, let us know if you'll be requiring our transport service to and from the airport.

Customer: I'll make sure to let you know. Does that incur a service charge or perhaps some presents to show our gratitude for the personal service?

Emily: Oh, don't worry about it. It is a free service, so if you would like to tip, you are welcome to do so. But hotel drivers do not accept gifts.

Customer: Thanks for your help.

Emily: My pleasure. Enjoy your stay at the Winchester.

groups.contentHtml:
1 Sea view
2 Handicap accessibility
3 Multiple meal options
4 Private dining
5 Group discount
6 Children's play area

analyses.content: Emily 明确提到 Star Hotel 提供免费在线预订，而且动作快还能订到极好的海景房（sea view rooms）。
Emily: The Star Hotel offers online bookings... and you can even book the gorgeous sea view rooms if you act quickly.
顾客后来确实说了“想看水景（nice view of the water）”，但这只是顾客的需求，真正提供这个设施的只有 Star Hotel。
Customer: Now, are there handicapped accessible rooms? Emily: Yes, all three options have access for the physically disabled.
不要因为顾客是在讨论完 Star Hotel 之后才问这个问题，就以为它只属于 Star Hotel，要抓取关键词 "all three"。
当顾客询问残疾人通道时，Emily 回答所有三个选项（all three options）都具备此设施。
For a full restaurant and room service, the Royal Hotel is your best bet.
题目问的是 "Multiple meal options"（多种餐饮选择），这直接对应原文的 "full restaurant"，排除了只提供 "limited menu" 的另外两家。
原文指出另外两家只有简单的早餐，而 Royal Hotel 提供完整的餐厅和客房服务（full restaurant and room service）。
Dinners are in a nice low-key but high-quality setting in the hotel's private dining room...
这个信息点紧跟在 Royal Hotel 的午餐介绍之后，不要因为后面即将提到其他酒店就走神。
Emily 介绍 Royal Hotel 的晚餐是在酒店高品质的**私人餐厅（private dining room）**提供的。
Emily: No, sorry, not at the Royal Hotel... It looks like there is one at the Winchester, 15% off when you book eight or more rooms.
这是一个典型的“否定陷阱”，先说了 Royal Hotel "No, sorry"，然后转折指向 Winchester，不要听到 discount 就急着选 Royal。
Emily 查阅后确认，Royal Hotel 没有折扣，但 Winchester 提供 15% 的团体折扣。
顾客决定预订 Winchester 后询问关于孩子的问题，Emily 确认那里有孩子们喜欢的 play place（游乐区）。
Customer: We'll book at the Winchester... Emily: Yes, in fact, it has a play place that kids just love...
此时对话焦点已经完全转移到了 Winchester Hotel，所以后续关于儿童设施的描述都是属于它的。

groups.contentHtml:
• The man needs to send his to the hotel.
• He also needs to make immediately.
• The hotel must be alerted in advance if guests will need help with .
• There is no need to prepare for hotel drivers.

analyses.content: I'll hold the block of rooms for you as soon as you send a deposit.
注意题目是 "send his..."，原文是 "send a..."，要抓取 send 后面的核心名词。
Emily 说明只要顾客寄送了 deposit（定金），就会为他们保留房间。
I recommend booking as soon as possible, so you probably want to send the invitations as soon as you know how many rooms to hold.
虽然题目用的动词 "make" 和原文 "send" 不完全一致，但根据语境“立刻去做的事情”，只有 invitations 符合逻辑。
Emily 建议顾客一旦确定房间数量，就尽快发出 invitations（邀请/请帖）。
...sometime before you arrive, let us know if you'll be requiring our transport service to and from the airport.
不要填 airport，那是目的地；题目问的是 "help with..."（需要什么方面的帮助/服务）。
Emily 提醒，如果需要机场往返的 transport（交通） 服务，需要在抵达前告知。
It is a free service, so if you would like to tip, you are welcome to do so. But hotel drivers do not accept gifts.
客户问的是 "presents"，但 Emily 回答的规矩是 "do not accept gifts"，填空题要优先填确定的事实或规则中的用词，且 "prepare gifts" 是常见搭配。
录音中 Emily 明确告知，虽然可以给小费，但酒店司机不接受 gifts（礼物）。
